name: dht22-wasm-gui
description: Browser GUI (Rust + WebAssembly): a relay-only dual-DHT22 sensor client

scripts.build: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen ./target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/dht22_wasm_gui.wasm --out-dir public/wasm --target web
scripts.build:debug: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen ./target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/debug/dht22_wasm_gui.wasm --out-dir public/wasm --target web --debug
